explainer.title: Voice notes use your microphone
explainer.body: Hold the button and say what you bought or used up. Your voice is turned into text for you to check. The recording is not stored.

denied.title: The microphone is blocked.
denied.body: To use voice notes, allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings (look for the lock or settings icon next to the address), then hold the button again.

unavailable: This browser cannot record audio, so voice notes are not available here.

voiceButton.label: Hold to record a Voice Note

listening.title: Listening
listening.hint: Let go to send · slide off to cancel
listening.toShopping: Goes to your Shopping List. Say “in the pantry” to add stock.
listening.toPantry: Goes to your Pantry. Say “on the list” for the Shopping List.
listening.tip: Hold to talk, let go to send

languageMenu.title: Scan Language
languageMenu.savedHint: Used for Voice Notes and the camera.

review.title: Review
review.subline_one: {{count}} change · nothing is saved until you Apply
review.subline_other: {{count}} changes · nothing is saved until you Apply
review.sublineBoth_one: {{count}} change on both lists · nothing is saved until you Apply
review.sublineBoth_other: {{count}} changes on both lists · nothing is saved until you Apply

reason.notUnderstood: Try saying it again as an add, a tick or a remove.

detail.notOnList: Not on your list, so it's added ticked
detail.unmatched: not in the catalog, saved as said
detail.lowToList: no {{name}} in the Pantry, so it goes on the list
detail.takesPicked: Takes {{amount}} from the batch you picked
detail.needsBatch: {{amount}} doesn't fit batches counted in {{unit}} · pick one
detail.lowHint: Shows in Suggestions until a new batch arrives

edit.locationDefault: Not said, so the usual place for this Ingredient
edit.whichBatch: Which batch did you use up?

footer.confirmHint: Nothing changes, and you'll have to say it again.

toast.already: {{name}} was already {{state}}, so that one counts as done.
toast.alreadyMany_one: {{name}} and {{count}} more were already done, so those count as done.
toast.alreadyMany_other: {{name}} and {{count}} more were already done, so those count as done.

send.failedHint: No connection. Your recording is kept.
send.nothingHint: Hold the button and speak close to the phone. This one doesn't count.
send.capHint: Voice is back tomorrow. Scans still work.
send.tooLong: That recording was too long. Try a shorter one.
send.unsupported: This browser's recording format isn't supported
send.tipFailed: Retry or discard the last note first
